The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9cf38a67706f91fa), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 15. statement: Let p : SY → D be a model, let s = f ⊗ a ≥ 0, and suppose that 0 < m0 := m(f > 0) < ∞. For r > 0, choose cr ∈ Q+ representing rG[a]. Then cr ≾ p(s) (0 < r < m0), p(s) ≾ cr (r > m0). (3.8) The following versions have fixed target cuts. If η, δ > 0, 0 < r < m(f > η), and c represents rG[(a − δ)+], then, for every 0 < κ < ηδ, c ≾ (p(f ⊗ a) − κ)+. (3.9) If r′ > m0 and ε > 0, then a representative b of r′G[a] has a positive cut (b − κ)+ such that (p(f ⊗ a) − ε)+ ≾ (b − κ)+. (3.10) The choices in these two displays can be made independently of the model p. The complete collection of such comparisons on the countable compact tests characterizes the model equation.
